title: Grateful Dead Live at Ice Palace on 1969-03-29
source: Fix for Charlie Miller source, patched with 4th-gen cassette.

ai_review.summary: Free downloadable soundboard capture of a ’69 Dark Star – excellent audio and a standout performance.
ai_review.review: The review highlights a high‑quality soundboard (SBD) recording of the 1969 Dark Star, noting that it’s freely available and unbeatable. The reviewer’s five‑star rating implies both superb sonic clarity and an electrifying rendition of the classic jam.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review, but it gives a perfect 5‑star rating praising both the soundboard source and the Dark Star performance; thus the combined show‑and‑recording score is very high.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls it a free, downloadable SBD, implying clear and well‑mixed audio.
